facts.fact: Allie 在公爵夫人的乡间别墅醒来，国王松了口气退开，Sophie 收回手。
facts.anchor: Beside me, the king released a breath of relief and immediately stepped back

facts.fact: 国王怒斥 Gregory 并用力推搡他胸口，指责他丢下他们等死。
facts.anchor: He shoved Gregory’s chest—hard. “You left us to die!”

facts.fact: Allie 怀疑自己与全境幽灵的蔓延有关，担心这是自己造成的。
facts.anchor: Could it be true? Was I somehow connected to the resurgence of ghosts across Wünder?

facts.fact: Sophie 拦住冲向国王的哥哥 Gregory，两人是兄妹。
facts.anchor: Sophie rushed to block his way. “Brother, don’t.”

facts.fact: 决斗中国王打落 Gregory 的剑，随后收手没有杀他。
facts.anchor: Gregory’s sword was knocked from his hand, clattering loudly across the stone floor.

facts.fact: Allie 拒绝随 Sophie 与 Gregory 去 Lucerne，表明自己留在国王身边。
Allie 说必须去 Hatter 的家，认为他是幽灵问题的专家。
facts.anchor: I must go to the Hatter’s house. I feel he ought to be able to answer many questions.

facts.fact: Gregory 要求国王至少给一周时间调查，国王随后让步、只杀有敌意的幽灵。
facts.anchor: Give us a week, at least, to investigate this further.
